Sleep Cycle Calculator

Time your bedtime or alarm to 90-minute sleep cycles so you wake up between cycles, feeling refreshed.

CyclesGo to bed at
Set your wake-up time to see bedtime options.

Based on average 90-minute cycles plus ~15 minutes to fall asleep. Real cycles vary — this is guidance, not precision.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose a mode: wake up at a set time, or sleep now.
  2. For a set time: enter when your alarm rings.
  3. Pick a bedtime from the 3–6 cycle options.
  4. For sleep-now mode: choose one of the suggested wake-up times.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Is every sleep cycle exactly 90 minutes?

Average sleep cycles last about 90 minutes, but real cycles range from 80 to 120 minutes and vary by person and night. The times are smart starting points, not guarantees.

Why wake at the end of a cycle?

Waking mid-cycle — especially out of deep sleep — causes grogginess. Waking at the end of a cycle, during light sleep, usually feels easier.

Can it tell me when to set my alarm if I sleep now?

Yes — switch to 'I am going to sleep now' and it gives wake-up times 4, 5 and 6 full cycles ahead, including 15 minutes to fall asleep.
